from typing import Annotated, TypedDict

from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END
from langgraph.graph.message import add_messages
from langgraph.types import interrupt
from langgraph.checkpoint.memory import InMemorySaver
from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage, SystemMessage
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI


class AgentState(TypedDict):
    messages: Annotated[list, add_messages]


def message_text(message) -> str:
    """Plain text of a message whose content may be a string or a list of blocks."""
    content = message.content
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    return "".join(b.get("text", "") for b in content if isinstance(b, dict))


def agent_input(system_prompt: str, history: list) -> list:
    """System prompt + the shared history as ONE user turn: earlier agents' replies are context for
    this agent, not its own turns (and Claude 5.5 models reject requests ending on an assistant turn)."""
    parts = [
        f"{'Request' if m.type == 'human' else 'Output from ' + (m.name or 'a previous step')}:\n{message_text(m)}"
        for m in history
    ]
    return [SystemMessage(content=system_prompt), HumanMessage(content="\n\n".join(parts) or "(no input)")]


class GateRejected(Exception):
    """Raised when a human reviewer rejects a gate; ends the run."""


def faq(state: AgentState) -> AgentState:
    """FAQ Agent"""
    llm = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4o-mini", temperature=0.3, max_tokens=512)
    reply = llm.invoke(agent_input("""Answer common customer support questions.""", state["messages"]))
    reply.name = "faq"
    return {"messages": [reply]}


def gate(state: AgentState) -> AgentState:
    """Escalation Gate"""
    last = message_text(state["messages"][-1]) if state["messages"] else ""
    decision = interrupt({"prompt": """Review this escalation request and approve or reject.""", "last_output": last, "timeout_seconds": 300})
    if not (isinstance(decision, dict) and decision.get("approved")):
        raise GateRejected("Rejected at gate \"Escalation Gate\"")
    return {"messages": []}


def escalation(state: AgentState) -> AgentState:
    """Escalation Agent"""
    llm = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4o", temperature=0.3, max_tokens=1024)
    reply = llm.invoke(agent_input("""Draft a careful reply for an approved escalation (e.g. a refund request).""", state["messages"]))
    reply.name = "escalation"
    return {"messages": [reply]}


def route_router(state: AgentState) -> str:
    """Route: Intent Router"""
    last = message_text(state["messages"][-1]) if state["messages"] else ""
    return "escalate" if "refund" in last.lower() else "faq"

})
